name: Pan-Fried Zucchini Egg Nests with Bacon & Tomato
instructions: Preheat two skillets over medium-high heat.
Once the skillets are hot, divide bacon between them and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve both skillets with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles.
Return both skillets (with drippings) to medium-high heat; divide the zucchini noodles and spices between them. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.

When the zucchini noodles are soft, reduce heat to medium-low. Using a spatula, divide and shape noodles into 8 flattened mounds (4 mounds per skillet), making an indent at the center of each to create a "nest."
Gently crack an egg into each "nest." Cover each skillet with a lid and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3-4 minutes; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
To serve, divide zucchini egg nests, bacon, and tomatoes between plates; season eggs with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
